p: came before the king: That is, was received into the king's favour and presence.
unto her: That he was her uncle, and had brought her up.
mischief of Haman the Agagite: Meaning, that he should abolish the wicked decrees, which he had made for the destruction of the Jews.
no man reverse: This was the law of the Medes and Persians, as in Da 6:15 nonetheless the king revoked the former decree granted to Haman for Esther's sake.
Sivan: Which contains part of May and part of June.
writing thereof: That is, in such letters and languages as was usual in every province.
their life: That is, to defend themselves against all who would assail them.
Adar: Which has part of February and part of March.
avenge themselves on their enemies: The king gave them permission to kill all who oppressed them.
gladness: He showed by the words that follow, what this light was.
became Jews: Conformed themselves to the Jew's religion.
